hypothesis: Within the fixed Q7 1,023-formula subset grammar, individual feature families and selected pairs have stable marginal or interaction effects on the strict-prior percentile rank of the realized quintet.

target_protocol.strict_prior: Use only the pinned Q7 rank row generated from draws strictly before the target; target outcome only evaluates that frozen rank.
target_protocol.target_update_order: score/write rank row before adding target draw to state

estimands.main_effect: For each feature i and target t, average [percentile(S union {i}) - percentile(S)] over all 511 non-empty subsets S of the other nine feature families.
estimands.pairwise_interaction: For each pair i,j and target t, average [p(S union {i,j}) - p(S union {i}) - p(S union {j}) + p(S)] over all 255 non-empty subsets S of the remaining eight feature families.

inference.correction: Holm-Bonferroni across all 55 registered Blind OOS main and pairwise interaction endpoints

interpretation: Factorial attribution over a fixed historical formula grammar. Main and pair effects are descriptive rank effects, not causal effects and not a deployable predictor. Historical Blind OOS is exposed, not virgin prospective evidence. Holm covers these 55 endpoints only, not all Q00-Q141 experimentation.
decision_rule: Flag a feature or pair only if Holm-adjusted p<0.05 and absolute Blind OOS mean effect>=0.005. No engine promotion or forecast selection.
